name: testing
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project testing --web

test.$comment: The target has to exist for the README's `nx test testing` to work, and for `nx affected -t test` to notice the library at all. `passWithNoTests` lives in vitest.config.mts, which is where review-guardrails.mjs looks for it.

lint.$comment: @nx/eslint/plugin infers this as `eslint:lint`, which `nx affected -t lint` does NOT match — the same reason libs/shared/ai-client declares it explicitly. Without it the eslint.config.mjs beside this file is never invoked.

typecheck.$comment: The library shipped with `"targets": {}`, so nothing in the pipeline looked at it. Its only source file imported a path alias that does not exist, and the repo-wide spec-types gate found it through a *different* project's tsconfig.
